description: A large crowd of young people in dark clothes, many holding yellow and black umbrellas, some in face masks, at night in rain on a city road. Tall lit skyscrapers rise behind. Tents and a barricade of tables sit on the central road, with banners hung on a railing and a mist of spray in the middle distance. Painterly style, edge to edge, no visible frame.
reason: Painted Chinese-character text is visible on the banners hung along the railing (white banner and yellow banner at the left). Repaint or regenerate without legible or painted lettering on the banners.
